# netcup_scp_user (Resource)

Updates an existing netcup SCP user account. Users cannot be created or deleted through the API; this resource adopts the user by `user_id` and applies `UserSave` fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_user" "example" {
  user_id = 12345

  language = "en"
  time_zone = "Europe/Berlin"

  show_nickname     = true
  passwordless_mode = false
  secure_mode       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `language` (String) Account language (`en` or `de`).
- `time_zone` (String) Account time zone.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user account.

### Optional

- `api_ip_login_restrictions` (String) Comma-separated list of IP addresses allowed for API login.
- `company` (String) Company name.
- `old_password` (String, Sensitive) Old password, required when changing the password.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) New password for the account.
- `passwordless_mode` (Boolean) Whether passwordless mode is enabled.
- `secure_mode` (Boolean) Whether secure mode is enabled.
- `show_nickname` (Boolean) Whether to show the server nickname.
- `soap_webservice_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the SOAP web service.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) User ID echoed from the API.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) Username of the account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# terraform import netcup_scp_user.example 12345
```
